senses.gloss:
इड् f. (also written इल् in Veda) [इल्-क्विप् वा लस्य डः]
—1 An offering or oblation, libation offered to the gods.
—2 Prayer, flow of speech.
—3 The earth.
—4 Food.
—5 The rainy season.
—6 The third of the five prayājas (इडो यजति).
—7 People or subjects. (pl.) The object of devotion.
.━{@Comp.@}: इड्देवता

इल् €6 P. (इलति, इयेल, ऐलीत्, एलितुम्, इलित) or €10 U. (इलयति
 or एलयति, ऐलयीत् or ऐलिलत्)
—1 To go, to move.
—2 To sleep.
—3 To throw, send, cast.
—4 To keep still, not to move.
—5 To become quiet. [cf. Germ. Eile, Gr. elao].
